summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, apartments and houses 15 to 20 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 19 m on this side, houses 15 to 17 m across the road; heavy tree cover.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars are parked nose to tail along the kerb, so a van fits in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a bend; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; several cars parked along both kerbs in the imagery.

flags: Low-lying: 6 m elevation, Brisbane River 177 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb; shaded most of the day, sun from the east filters through.

best_section.where: Austral Street west kerb, under the trees beside the apartment block
